prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen, keep field sanitation, scout seedbed and tillering fields after cloudy humid nights

prevention: Use balanced fertilizer, avoid excess nitrogen, keep water movement controlled, remove heavily infected seedlings

prevention: Keep balanced plant spacing, avoid excess nitrogen, remove weeds on bunds, monitor dense humid canopy
treatment: If lesions spread upward, consult DAE/SAAO and apply registered sheath blight fungicide at label dose

treatment: If threshold is crossed, drain field briefly and use a registered planthopper insecticide only after local extension advice
